candidate_workaround: Query Git's indexed path list once, then apply one exact-name alternation and adjudicate only returned paths.
failure_signature: Twenty independent repository-wide content searches exceed their bounded window without returning collision evidence.
recurrence_guard: Do not launch one full historical content scan per proposed package name.
rollback: Retain the timeout, create no package from the failed scan, and use only indexed-path results.
scope_boundary: Indexed filename evidence only; content semantics still require manual proposal review.
title: Use one indexed-path collision audit instead of repeated full scans
trigger_preconditions: Many proposed family-current package names require an exact pre-build collision check.
